beats.label: S1 · Rick wakes
beats.text: Rick wakes from a coma into a walker apocalypse, meets a widowed Morgan, and drives to Atlanta hunting for his wife Lori and son Carl.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Rick's motivation and the world in one line — the engine of the whole show.

beats.label: S1 · Atlanta rescue
beats.text: Atlanta is a walker trap. Glenn rescues Rick from a tank; they escape a rooftop stand-off, but leave the volatile Merle Dixon cuffed and abandoned.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Glenn as Rick's first ally and sets up Daryl's grudge over Merle that colours S2.

beats.label: S1 · Camp reunion
beats.text: At a quarry camp outside the city Rick reunites with Lori and Carl — and finds his old partner Shane, who had told Lori that Rick was dead and moved on with her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Rick–Shane–Lori triangle is the entire spine of S2; this is where it starts.

beats.label: S1 · Camp overrun
beats.text: A walker attack overruns the camp, killing Andrea's sister Amy and biting Jim. Rick pushes the group toward the CDC, believing science offers a cure.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the illusion the camp is safe and sets Rick's authority over Shane's caution.

beats.label: S1 · The CDC
beats.text: At the CDC the last scientist, Jenner, proves the disease is incurable and rigs the building to detonate. Rick argues them out and Jenner whispers a secret to him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The whispered secret — everyone is infected — becomes the S2 finale's bombshell.

beats.label: S1 · East again
beats.text: The group escapes as the CDC self-destructs and moves on. Shane is fraying, Lori sits between two men, and Rick carries a secret he won't share.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes S1 with all three S2 threads live: no home, Shane splitting, Rick withholding.

cliffhanger.text: The group is homeless again, driving east with no plan while Shane and Rick circle each other over Lori. Rick alone knows Jenner's secret, and hasn't told anyone.
questions: What did Jenner whisper to Rick at the CDC?
Can Rick and Shane share a group, or will one destroy the other?
Where can the group possibly go from here?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Former sheriff's deputy who woke from a coma into the apocalypse; now reluctant leader of the group, carrying Jenner's secret.

characters.name: Lori Grimes
characters.line: Rick's wife, reunited with him at the quarry camp; caught between her husband and Shane, the man she turned to when she believed Rick was dead.

characters.name: Shane Walsh
characters.line: Rick's former partner who told Lori that Rick was dead and started a relationship with her; visibly fraying now that Rick is back in charge.

characters.name: Carl Grimes
characters.line: Rick and Lori's young son, safe with the group as they leave the ruins of the CDC behind.

characters.name: Glenn Rhee
characters.line: Quick-thinking Atlanta scavenger who rescued Rick from the tank and became one of the group's most reliable runners.

characters.name: Daryl Dixon
characters.line: Volatile hunter and Merle's younger brother, furious that the group left Merle handcuffed on the Atlanta rooftop.

beats.label: S2 · Sophia missing
beats.text: On the road to Fort Benning a herd separates Carol's daughter Sophia from the group. During the search Otis accidentally shoots Carl, who is rushed to Hershel's farm.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two open searches — Sophia and Carl's life — anchor the whole season on the farm.

beats.label: S2 · The barn's secret
beats.text: Shane sacrifices Otis as bait to save Carl. Hershel heals the boy but hides a barn of walkers, including his own family, believing the disease is curable.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Shane's first murder and the season's central lie about the barn.

beats.label: S2 · Lori is pregnant
beats.text: Lori discovers she is pregnant with Shane's child; Rick learns the truth and quietly accepts it. Shane hears too, and starts treating her and Carl as his to protect.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts the S1 triangle on a hard timer that ends only when one of them dies.

beats.label: S2 · Sophia in the barn
beats.text: Shane forces open the barn and guns the walkers down. The last one out is Sophia; Rick steps forward and puts her down himself, shattering what's left of the group's hope.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season's hopeful mode and re-centres it on the Rick–Shane conflict.

beats.label: S2 · Rick kills Shane
beats.text: A captured stranger, Randall, exposes a violent gang nearby. Shane murders him and lures Rick into the woods to kill him — Rick stabs Shane first, and Carl shoots his corpse.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Resolves S1's central conflict and creates the resentment that will drive Lori and Carl in S3.

beats.label: S2 · The farm falls
beats.text: The gunshot draws a huge herd that overruns Hershel's farm. On the highway Rick reveals Jenner's secret: everyone is infected. He then declares himself the group's dictator.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Costs the group its home and inaugurates the authoritarian Rick who runs S3.

beats.label: S2 · Hooded stranger
beats.text: Separated in the panic, Andrea is met by a mysterious hooded woman. In the distance, the group sees a prison.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Debuts Michonne — a season away from becoming a lead — and points at the prison.

cliffhanger.text: The group is homeless again with a fractured leader, a pregnant Lori, and a prison on the horizon they might have to fight for. Andrea is missing and in a stranger's hands.
questions: Can the group survive Rick's descent into dictator?
Who is the hooded woman who rescued Andrea?
Will they take the prison — and what lives inside it?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Group leader who put down a walker Sophia himself, killed Shane in self-defence, and has just declared the group a dictatorship after revealing everyone is infected.

characters.name: Shane Walsh
characters.line: Rick's old partner, unravelling over Lori's pregnancy and Carl; murdered Randall, tried to kill Rick in the woods, and was stabbed by Rick and shot by Carl.

characters.name: Lori Grimes
characters.line: Pregnant, likely with Shane's child; Rick knows and has accepted it, and she is fleeing Hershel's overrun farm with what's left of the group.

characters.name: Carl Grimes
characters.line: Recovered from Otis's stray bullet and hardened by it; put down his father's reanimated best friend with a bullet of his own.

characters.name: Hershel Greene
characters.line: Farm owner and veterinarian who sheltered the group and hid his walker family in the barn; his farm has now fallen and he is on the road with Rick's people.

characters.name: Sophia
characters.line: Carol's young daughter, lost from the group early in the season; found as a walker in Hershel's barn and shot by Rick.

characters.name: Otis
characters.line: Hershel's farmhand who accidentally shot Carl; sacrificed by Shane as walker bait during the run for medical supplies.

characters.name: Andrea
characters.line: Grieving, harder-edged survivor separated from the group during the farm's fall; met in the woods by a mysterious hooded stranger.

beats.label: S3 · Take the prison
beats.text: After a hard winter the group takes the prison, clearing walkers block by block. Hershel is bitten and Rick amputates his leg in time; five convicts are found inside.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the season's base and reintroduces the group as hardened.

beats.label: S3 · Woodbury
beats.text: Andrea is nursed by her hooded rescuer, Michonne. Merle Dixon — alive — captures them for Woodbury, a clean town run by the charismatic, secretly psychopathic Governor.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the season's antagonist and rival society, and revives Merle.

beats.label: S3 · Lori dies
beats.text: Walkers breach the prison. T-Dog dies; Lori goes into labour and Maggie cuts the baby out to save her, killing Lori. Carl shoots his mother to keep her from turning.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills Lori and finishes the ‘innocent child' version of Carl; Rick unravels from here.

beats.label: S3 · Sides drawn
beats.text: Michonne finds the Governor's undead daughter and trophy heads; he exiles her and she finds the prison. Merle captures Glenn and Maggie for the Governor to torture.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Pushes Michonne to Rick's side and starts open war between the two towns.

beats.label: S3 · Raid on Woodbury
beats.text: Rick's team raids Woodbury to rescue Glenn and Maggie. Michonne kills the Governor's daughter and takes his eye; Andrea stays behind, still believing in him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Michonne locks in with the group; Andrea's misplaced loyalty becomes fatal soon.

beats.label: S3 · Merle's end
beats.text: The Governor attacks the prison and later takes Andrea prisoner. Merle sabotages his men and dies; Daryl finds his brother reanimated and puts him down himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes Daryl's S1 grievance and clears the deck for his role as Rick's second.

beats.label: S3 · The town he built
beats.text: The Governor's soldiers refuse to slaughter the prison; he massacres them himself and flees. Rick finds a suicidal Andrea too late, then welcomes the Woodbury refugees home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Leaves the Governor alive as an S4 threat and doubles the prison's civilian dependents.

cliffhanger.text: The prison is safer than ever with Woodbury's citizens absorbed, but the Governor is loose with a small crew, humiliated and vengeful. Rick has stepped back from sole command.
questions: Where has the Governor gone, and will he come back for the prison?
Can Rick raise a healthy Judith while stepping down from leadership?
Is Carl still salvageable after everything he's had to do?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Prison leader, widowed by Lori's death in childbirth and cracking under the strain; has just welcomed the Woodbury refugees into his home.

characters.name: The Governor
characters.line: Charismatic, secretly psychopathic ruler of Woodbury who lost his undead daughter and an eye to Michonne; massacred his own soldiers and fled after his failed war on the prison.

characters.name: Carl Grimes
characters.line: Rick's son, forced to shoot his own mother to keep her from turning, and now fighting alongside the adults as a soldier.

characters.name: Daryl Dixon
characters.line: Rick's right hand, briefly torn away by his reunion with Merle; had to put his own reanimated brother down after the Governor killed him.

characters.name: Michonne
characters.line: Katana-wielding loner who nursed a sick Andrea through the winter, was taken in by Woodbury, and became one of Rick's people after killing the Governor's daughter.

characters.name: Andrea
characters.line: Loved the Governor and stayed in Woodbury despite the warnings; taken prisoner by him and found by Rick too late, dying by her own hand from a walker bite.

characters.name: Merle Dixon
characters.line: Daryl's brother, alive as the Governor's lieutenant; turned on his boss to protect the prison group, was killed, and reanimated for Daryl to put down.

characters.name: Hershel Greene
characters.line: Elder of the prison group; had his walker-bitten leg amputated by Rick in time to save his life.

characters.name: Maggie Greene
characters.line: Hershel's daughter, who cut Lori's baby out to save her and was captured by Merle and tortured in Woodbury alongside Glenn.

characters.name: Glenn Rhee
characters.line: Captured with Maggie and tortured by Merle for the Governor; rescued in Rick's raid on Woodbury.

beats.label: S4 · The plague
beats.text: Months into a peaceful prison run by a council, an aggressive flu strain kills survivors. Carol quietly murders two infected friends to try to stop the spread.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Carol's exile and the erosion of council-run peace.

beats.label: S4 · Carol exiled
beats.text: Rick confronts Carol on a supply run and exiles her from the prison, keeping the reason from Tyreese — whose girlfriend she killed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Carol from the prison so she survives its fall and can reunite with Tyreese.

beats.label: S4 · New Governor
beats.text: In flashback the exiled Governor takes over a new group, murdering their leader Martinez, and turns them toward the prison as a home for the family he's adopted.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Explains why the Governor comes back and reframes him as a father, not just a warlord.

beats.label: S4 · Prison falls
beats.text: The Governor attacks with a tank, beheads Hershel, and Michonne fatally stabs him mid-brawl. The prison falls; the group scatters in every direction into the wilderness.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills off the season antagonist but destroys the group's home and separates everyone.

beats.label: S4 · The tracks
beats.text: Signs to a place called Terminus draw the splintered groups along the railroad. Abraham, Rosita and Eugene find Glenn — Eugene claims he can stop the walker outbreak in Washington.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Abraham's crew and the destination that pulls everyone into one boxcar.

beats.label: S4 · Look at the flowers
beats.text: Carol, Tyreese and baby Judith travel with two sisters. Lizzie kills Mika to prove walkers are harmless; Carol quietly executes her and confesses to Tyreese about Karen.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Bonds Carol to Tyreese and keeps Judith alive off-screen through the finale.

beats.label: S4 · Terminus
beats.text: Terminus turns out to be a trap. Rick's group is herded into a boxcar with the other survivors; Rick vows their captors have picked the wrong people to mess with.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The set-piece the whole S5 premiere resolves; everyone's location is defined by it.

cliffhanger.text: Rick's group is locked inside a Terminus boxcar. Carol, Tyreese and Judith are still on the road. Beth was kidnapped by a car with a white cross on its window.
questions: Can Rick fight his way out of Terminus with his people intact?
Who took Beth, and is she alive?
Is Eugene's promise of a cure in Washington real?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Stepped down from leadership to farm the prison; now scattered from his people and herded into a boxcar at Terminus, promising their captors have picked the wrong group.

characters.name: Carol Peletier
characters.line: Quietly executed two flu-infected friends and later young Lizzie; exiled from the prison by Rick, she now travels with Tyreese and baby Judith.

characters.name: Michonne
characters.line: Rick's closest fighter, who dealt the Governor his death blow mid-battle before the prison fell around them.

characters.name: The Governor
characters.line: Took over a new group and murdered its leader Martinez; attacked the prison with a tank, beheaded Hershel, and was mortally stabbed by Michonne before Lilly executed him.

characters.name: Tyreese
characters.line: Grieving survivor travelling with Carol and baby Judith; Carol has just confessed to him that she killed his girlfriend Karen back at the prison.

characters.name: Abraham Ford
characters.line: Ex-soldier travelling with Rosita and Eugene, escorting the self-proclaimed scientist toward Washington to stop the walker outbreak; found Glenn on the tracks to Terminus.

beats.label: S5 · Terminus burns
beats.text: Carol destroys Terminus with a walker herd, freeing Rick's group. Ex-Terminus survivors ambush them later and cannibalise Bob before Rick's group can wipe them out.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reunites the boxcar cast and closes the Terminus arc so the season can move to Alexandria.

beats.label: S5 · Grady
beats.text: Beth is being held at Grady Memorial by a corrupt hospital cop, Dawn. A prisoner swap goes wrong: Beth is shot dead and Daryl kills Dawn in front of everyone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the S4 Beth thread and gives Daryl a grief that Aaron picks up on later.

beats.label: S5 · Eugene's lie
beats.text: Eugene admits his cure story is a lie he told to secure Abraham's protection; Abraham beats him unconscious and the mission to Washington collapses.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the season's stated goal and forces everyone to just try to survive again.

beats.label: S5 · Aaron
beats.text: Tyreese dies from a bite on a doomed run. Starving and grieving, the group is found on the road by Aaron, a scout for a walled community called Alexandria.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the group to the setting the rest of the series is built around.

beats.label: S5 · Alexandria
beats.text: Alexandria is real: safe walls, running water, a leader named Deanna. Rick, Carol and Daryl decide the residents are too soft to survive and quietly plan for control.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Frames Rick's group as hostile occupiers from day one — the S6 pattern.

beats.label: S5 · Pete
beats.text: A run for solar panels goes wrong; Noah is torn apart when a panicked townsman named Nicholas sacrifices him. Rick confronts town surgeon Pete over abusing his wife Jessie.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up Rick's public rift with Alexandria and gets him ready to kill Pete openly.

beats.label: S5 · Morgan returns
beats.text: At a town meeting to exile Rick, Pete kills Deanna's husband. Deanna orders Rick to execute Pete — just as Daryl and Aaron return with a wanderer from Rick's past, Morgan.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Grants Rick amnesty for the killing and re-plants Morgan for his S6 pacifism arc.

cliffhanger.text: Rick has publicly killed a townsman with Alexandria watching, and Deanna has sanctioned it. A pack called the Wolves has already been marking houses beyond the walls.
questions: Can Rick's group and Alexandria actually become one community?
What are the Wolves preparing for?
Has Morgan's philosophy of no killing survived the road?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Reunited with his people at Alexandria; a step from exile when Deanna orders him to kill Pete instead, just as Morgan arrives at the gate.

characters.name: Daryl Dixon
characters.line: Rick's most trusted fighter; killed the corrupt cop Dawn at Grady Memorial after Beth was shot, and now recruits with Aaron for Alexandria.

characters.name: Carol Peletier
characters.line: Playing a meek housewife inside Alexandria while quietly agreeing with Rick that the residents can't survive and the group should take control.

characters.name: Morgan Jones
characters.line: The Georgia neighbour Rick met on day one, following his trail across the country; has just walked into Alexandria as Rick prepares to execute Pete.

characters.name: Deanna Monroe
characters.line: Founder and leader of Alexandria; ordered Rick to kill town surgeon Pete after Pete murdered her husband at the meeting called to exile Rick.

characters.name: Aaron
characters.line: Alexandria's recruiter who found the group starving on the road and brought them home; returns with Daryl and Morgan just as things boil over.

characters.name: Pete
characters.line: Alexandria's surgeon, exposed by Rick as a wife-beater; killed Deanna's husband and is condemned by Deanna to be executed by Rick.

beats.label: S6 · The quarry
beats.text: A herd of thousands trapped in a quarry is a slow-motion threat; Rick's plan to walk them away is upset when a horn from Alexandria pulls half of them back to the town.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's central danger and shows Rick's outsider plan can't get clean execution.

beats.label: S6 · Wolves
beats.text: The Wolves invade Alexandria while it's undefended. Carol massacres them in the streets and Morgan secretly imprisons the one Wolf he can't bring himself to kill.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Widens the Carol–Morgan split over killing that will pay off in S6 mid and S7.

beats.label: S6 · Alexandria falls
beats.text: The abandoned herd reaches Alexandria and the walls give way. Ron shoots at Rick and blinds Carl's eye by mistake; the group makes a last stand until Daryl arrives with fire.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Rick's group as Alexandria's actual leadership and marks Carl permanently.

beats.label: S6 · Hilltop
beats.text: Two months on, a stranger named Jesus leads Rick to Hilltop, a farming colony being extorted by a mysterious group called the Saviors. Maggie brokers a deal: kill them for food.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Jesus, Hilltop, the Saviors and Negan's name — the S7 world.

beats.label: S6 · Pre-emptive kill
beats.text: Rick's crew slaughters sleeping Saviors in their beds. Carol quietly starts to unravel from what she's done; Maggie and Carol are then captured by Savior women in retaliation.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Rick's confidence peaks just before the season punishes it — the S7 humbling begins here.

beats.label: S6 · Boxed in
beats.text: Every route to a pregnant, sick Maggie's doctor at Hilltop is blocked. The group is captured, one by one, and forced to their knees before the RV headlights of the Saviors' leader.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Rick's group on their knees — the position the S7 premiere resumes from.

beats.label: S6 · Lucille
beats.text: Negan, holding a barbed-wire bat named Lucille, tells the kneeling group he's picking one of them to teach the rest a lesson. He swings — the victim is not shown.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The literal cliffhanger; withholding the victim is the S6→S7 hook.

cliffhanger.text: Rick's group kneels in a clearing; Negan has just bludgeoned one of them to death, but the audience does not know who. Everyone Rick loves is watching.
questions: Who did Negan kill?
Can Rick's group possibly beat a Savior force this large and organised?
What deal will Rick have to make to save the survivors?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Now knelt in a clearing before Negan, alongside his people, after his plan to preempt the Saviors ended with the whole group captured.

characters.name: Negan
characters.line: Leader of the Saviors, holding a barbed-wire bat named Lucille; has just chosen a victim from Rick's kneeling group and swung.

characters.name: Maggie Rhee
characters.line: Pregnant and gravely ill, unable to reach Hilltop's doctor; kneeling in the clearing with the rest of the group as Negan makes his example.

characters.name: Daryl Dixon
characters.line: Wounded and captured with the group; on his knees in front of Negan when the bat comes down.

characters.name: Carl Grimes
characters.line: Blinded in one eye by Ron during Alexandria's fall; among those kneeling before Negan.

characters.name: Carol Peletier
characters.line: Fought her way to the armory during the Wolves' invasion of Alexandria and armed the survivors, and is quietly beginning to unravel from what she has done.

beats.label: S7 · Two swings
beats.text: Negan kills Abraham. When Daryl punches him, Negan kills Glenn too and drags Daryl away as a prisoner. Rick is broken into public submission.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Answers S6's cliffhanger and defines the terms for the rest of the season.

beats.label: S7 · The Kingdom
beats.text: Carol and Morgan reach the Kingdom, a walled community with a tiger, ruled by a theatrical King Ezekiel who is also secretly paying tribute to the Saviors.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the third community and the ally Rick will need to raise an army.

beats.label: S7 · Submission
beats.text: The Saviors take Alexandria's furniture, weapons and pride. Rick renounces leadership and tells everyone to obey; only Rosita and Eugene start crafting a bullet for revenge.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows how deep the loss went and starts the slow rebuild toward war.

beats.label: S7 · Escape and Oceanside
beats.text: Tara stumbles onto Oceanside, an all-female community hiding from the Saviors, and swears silence. Daryl escapes the Sanctuary with help from Jesus and a mystery insider.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants two future allies (Oceanside, mystery insider) and returns Daryl to the fight.

beats.label: S7 · Rick decides
beats.text: Negan guts Spencer in Alexandria's street; Rosita's revenge shot misses and Arat kills Olivia. Rick sees the price of submission and finally chooses to fight.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the season from resistance to open coalition-building.

beats.label: S7 · Sasha's plan
beats.text: Rick tours Hilltop, Kingdom and the Scavengers stitching an alliance; Sasha breaks into the Sanctuary to kill Negan, is captured, and swallows Eugene's poison in her coffin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Assembles the coalition and closes Sasha's arc as a sacrificial decoy.

beats.label: S7 · War begins
beats.text: The Scavengers double-cross Rick at the gates. As the Saviors close in, Kingdom and Hilltop fighters ride in — the war for the whole region has begun.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks in the four-community alliance and starts All-Out War.

cliffhanger.text: Rick's coalition — Alexandria, Hilltop, Kingdom — is now openly at war with Negan. Eugene is inside the Sanctuary as a defector, and Sasha has just died as a decoy.
questions: Can four small communities actually beat the Saviors?
Whose side is Eugene really on now?
Who is the mystery insider that helped Daryl escape — and will they help again?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Broken by Negan into public submission, then jolted awake by fresh atrocities; now stitching Hilltop, Kingdom and Alexandria into an alliance for war.

characters.name: Negan
characters.line: Leader of the Saviors who killed Abraham and Glenn, took Daryl prisoner, and now faces Rick's coalition at the Alexandria gates.

characters.name: Daryl Dixon
characters.line: Held prisoner in the Sanctuary as Negan tried to break him; escaped with Jesus and a mystery insider's help, back at Rick's side for the coming war.

characters.name: Carol Peletier
characters.line: Withdrew from the fight in isolation; drawn back in through the Kingdom and Ezekiel, now standing with the alliance.

characters.name: Ezekiel
characters.line: Theatrical King of the Kingdom, a walled community with a tiger; secretly paying tribute to the Saviors but now committing his fighters to Rick's war.

characters.name: Rosita Espinosa
characters.line: Furious over Abraham's death; worked with Eugene on a bullet meant for Negan, missed her shot in Alexandria, and got Olivia killed instead.

characters.name: Eugene Porter
characters.line: Kidnapped by Negan and coerced into working for the Saviors; poisoned Sasha in her coffin at her own request before she could be used against Rick.

beats.label: S8 · The siege
beats.text: Rick's alliance attacks the Sanctuary, tears its fences down and floods it with walkers. Gabriel ends up trapped inside a trailer with Negan alone.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens All-Out War and locks Negan and Gabriel together for the season's slow midpoint.

beats.label: S8 · The cost
beats.text: Attacks on Savior satellite outposts cost lives on both sides. Aaron's partner Eric is killed and Ezekiel loses his fighters, his tiger Shiva, and his confidence.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows the war grinding down Rick's allies and ends the Kingdom's fairy-tale mode.

beats.label: S8 · Carl's bite
beats.text: Eugene's plan lets Negan and the Saviors escape the Sanctuary. Alexandria burns; while getting Siddiq to safety, Carl reveals to Rick that he was bitten during their journey home.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The bombshell that reframes the whole season around Carl's coming death.

beats.label: S8 · Carl's letter
beats.text: Carl dies pleading with Rick to build a future that includes Negan. Morgan and Carol retake the Kingdom from the Saviors; Henry kills their occupier Gavin.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Rick's son and plants the ideological seed that decides the finale.

beats.label: S8 · Simon overreaches
beats.text: Simon massacres the Scavengers alone against Negan's orders; a captured Negan learns of it, and Dwight is exposed as Rick's mole inside the Sanctuary.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Isolates Negan from his lieutenants and pushes the Saviors toward internal collapse.

beats.label: S8 · Tainted bullets
beats.text: Negan taints Savior weapons with walker blood. The bloody Hilltop battle turns the surviving Saviors, including Alden, against their own leadership.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shifts the balance of power and creates the ex-Saviors who will live at the Sanctuary in S9.

beats.label: S8 · Rick spares Negan
beats.text: Eugene sabotages the ammunition. In the final battle Rick cuts Negan's throat but has him saved and imprisoned; a furious Maggie vows to move against Rick for it.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The decision the whole show pivots on: Negan alive, Maggie broken with Rick.

cliffhanger.text: The war is over and Rick has kept Negan alive in a cell. Maggie vows to move against Rick in the future, and the communities have to rebuild from scratch.
questions: Can peace with the Saviors' survivors last with Negan alive?
How long before Maggie makes her move against Rick?
What kind of society do these communities become once the fighting stops?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Won the war and cut Negan's throat, then chose to save him for a cage; his son's dying wish for a shared future now shapes what he does next.

characters.name: Negan
characters.line: Turned Savior weapons with walker blood and lost anyway; throat cut by Rick, saved on Rick's orders, now imprisoned in Alexandria.

characters.name: Maggie Rhee
characters.line: Hilltop's leader through the bloody final battle; furious that Rick spared Negan and vowing to move against Rick because of it.

characters.name: Ezekiel
characters.line: Lost his fighters and his tiger Shiva; rescued by Morgan and Carol as they retook the Kingdom from the Saviors.

characters.name: Carl Grimes
characters.line: Rick and Lori's son, bitten in secret while saving Siddiq during Alexandria's fall; died pleading with Rick to build a future that includes Negan.

beats.label: S9 · Rebuilding
beats.text: Eighteen months on, the communities are rebuilding. Rick and Michonne beg a chilly Maggie for help for the starving Sanctuary; she has Gregory hanged for trying to kill her.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the new peacetime dynamic and shows Maggie is not moving on.

beats.label: S9 · The bridge
beats.text: A bridge project unites the groups but bitter Saviors go missing; Oceanside is quietly killing them. Anne — formerly Jadis — is trading people to a helicopter-borne group.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the helicopter allies and the fault line that pulls Rick off the board.

beats.label: S9 · Rick impaled
beats.text: Rick delays Maggie's plan to execute Negan; she sees his life is worse than death and spares him. Rick then herds walkers on horseback, is thrown, and impaled on rebar.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Negan as a target from Maggie and puts Rick in a life-or-death corner.

beats.label: S9 · Rick vanishes
beats.text: Rick blows the bridge to kill the herd. Everyone believes he died; Anne finds him alive and flies him away in her allies' helicopter to a place no one else knows about.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Writes Rick out and installs Michonne as Alexandria's leader for the second half.

beats.label: S9 · Time jump
beats.text: Six years later Michonne rules Alexandria in isolation. She takes in Magna's group; young Judith is a fighter. A walker whispers and stabs Jesus through the chest.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Redefines the show's cast and unveils the Whisperer premise in one beat.

beats.label: S9 · Alpha and Lydia
beats.text: The Whisperers are people wearing walker skins, led by the abusive Alpha. Her daughter Lydia defects to Daryl and Henry, and Carol's stepson Henry is soon captured too.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces the Alpha–Lydia axis that everything in S10 keys off of.

beats.label: S9 · The pikes
beats.text: Alpha stakes a border with the severed heads of Enid, Tara, Henry and seven others of Rick's people. A blizzard hits, and a stranger's voice comes over the radio.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's atrocity, the war it demands in S10, and the S10 radio thread all in one image.

cliffhanger.text: A whole line of Rick's people are on pikes, the Kingdom is abandoned to a blizzard, and someone unknown is transmitting on the radio for anyone still alive to answer.
questions: Who is the voice on the radio?
Can the communities survive Alpha's border without provoking her again?
What will Rick's daughter Judith grow up to be?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Blew the bridge to save the communities from the herd and was believed dead by his people; found alive by Anne and flown off in her helicopter to somewhere no one else knows.

characters.name: Michonne
characters.line: Now the isolationist leader of Alexandria; has taken in Magna's group and is raising a fighter of a daughter in Judith.

characters.name: Daryl Dixon
characters.line: Living rough in the woods; sheltered defector Lydia and the boy Henry, and is now hunting Alpha after finding Henry's severed head on her border.

characters.name: Carol Peletier
characters.line: Married to Ezekiel and stepmother to Henry; devastated after finding Henry's head among the pikes Alpha has staked out.

characters.name: Judith Grimes
characters.line: Rick and Michonne's daughter, growing up in isolationist Alexandria; already a young fighter.

characters.name: Negan
characters.line: Still imprisoned in Alexandria, spared by Maggie who decided his cell was worse than death.

characters.name: Alpha
characters.line: Abusive leader of the Whisperers, who wear walker skins to move with the dead; has staked her border with the severed heads of ten of Rick's people.

characters.name: Maggie Rhee
characters.line: Chose to spare Negan after seeing his suffering; hanged Gregory for trying to have her killed before departing with her son.

characters.name: Anne
characters.line: The former Jadis, quietly trading people to a helicopter-borne group; found the impaled Rick alive and flew him away.

characters.name: Henry
characters.line: Carol's stepson, Ezekiel's ward; ran off with defector Lydia, was captured by the Whisperers, and killed by Alpha as one of the ten pike heads.

beats.label: S10 · Border tensions
beats.text: Months of quiet end when a Soviet satellite crashes in Whisperer territory. Carol is fixated on killing Alpha, who is watching Alexandria from the trees.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets the season's driver: Carol's revenge is going to force everyone's hand.

beats.label: S10 · Spies exposed
beats.text: Gamma poisons Alexandria's water; Whisperer spy Dante strangles Siddiq and is later murdered in his cell by Gabriel. Gamma defects when Carol shows her Lydia is alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the infiltration arc and swaps Gamma over to Rick's people.

beats.label: S10 · The cave
beats.text: Carol chases Alpha's horde into a cave and traps Connie and Magna inside a dynamite blast. Beta invades Alexandria through a secret tunnel, and Alpha recovers stronger than ever.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Costs Connie, humbles Carol, and forces her to a more extreme plan.

beats.label: S10 · Alpha's head
beats.text: Carol secretly frees Negan and sends him to kill Alpha from inside the Whisperer camp. Alpha burns Hilltop to the ground; Negan slits her throat and brings Carol the head.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes the season's antagonist and repositions Negan as an uneasy ally.

beats.label: S10 · Rick is alive
beats.text: Michonne travels with a stranger, Virgil, to a naval base that turns out to be a trap. She escapes and finds evidence that Rick Grimes may still be alive.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Rick back on the board as a live storyline for the first time since S9.

beats.label: S10 · Beta's stand
beats.text: Michonne leaves the group to search for Rick. Beta leads the leaderless horde to Alexandria; the group flees to a hospital, then Beta is killed by Daryl and the herd is destroyed.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Whisperer war and removes Michonne from the day-to-day cast.

beats.label: S10 · New threats
beats.text: Eugene's radio contact Stephanie promises to meet him; on the road his group is captured by uniformed soldiers of a rich, hidden society. Maggie returns, her home destroyed by Reapers.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the two S11 antagonists — the Commonwealth and the Reapers — and brings Maggie back.

cliffhanger.text: Michonne is gone chasing evidence that Rick lives. Eugene's group is a hostage of a rich, uniformed society. Maggie has returned with a new group being hunted by an unknown enemy called the Reapers.
questions: Who are the well-armed soldiers holding Eugene?
Who are the Reapers, and why are they hunting Maggie?
Where is Rick, and will Michonne actually find him?

characters.name: Daryl Dixon
characters.line: Rick's oldest surviving fighter; killed Beta at the hospital and helped destroy the leaderless Whisperer horde attacking Alexandria.

characters.name: Carol Peletier
characters.line: Consumed with hunting Alpha; got Connie and Magna trapped in the cave, then secretly freed Negan to assassinate Alpha and brought the head back herself.

characters.name: Negan
characters.line: Freed from his Alexandria cell by Carol as her secret weapon; infiltrated the Whisperer camp and slit Alpha's throat.

characters.name: Alpha
characters.line: Leader of the Whisperers, watching Alexandria from the trees; burned Hilltop to the ground before Negan slit her throat in a cabin after luring her there.

characters.name: Maggie Rhee
characters.line: Returned at the end of the season, her home destroyed by a group called the Reapers.

characters.name: Eugene Porter
characters.line: Radio contact with a stranger named Stephanie drew him and a small group to a meeting on the road, where they were captured by uniformed soldiers.

characters.name: Judith Grimes
characters.line: Growing up in Alexandria under Michonne; among those forced to flee to the hospital during Beta's siege.

characters.name: Michonne
characters.line: Chased a stranger named Virgil to a naval-base trap, escaped, and found evidence Rick may still be alive; left the group to search for him.

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Long missing since the bridge; evidence Michonne uncovers on Virgil's island suggests he is still alive out there somewhere.

characters.name: Beta
characters.line: Alpha's giant enforcer; took over the Whisperer horde after her death and led it against Alexandria before Daryl killed him at the hospital.

beats.label: S11 · Meridian
beats.text: Alexandria is starving. Maggie leads a team back to her old base Meridian for food; Negan abandons her mid-escape, and the Reapers ambush them in the woods.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Opens the season on the food crisis and reignites the Maggie–Negan rift.

beats.label: S11 · The Commonwealth
beats.text: Eugene's group learns the soldiers work for the Commonwealth, a wealthy city of tens of thousands run by Governor Pamela Milton, with a rigid class system.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the last major society and its class fault line — the engine of the back half.

beats.label: S11 · Reapers and reunion
beats.text: The Reapers, led by Pope, are Daryl's ex-partner Leah's crew. Maggie's team uses walkers to sack Meridian; six months on, Maggie leads Hilltop while Daryl wears Commonwealth armour.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the Reapers arc and jumps the show into the Commonwealth era.

beats.label: S11 · Lance's coup
beats.text: Deputy Governor Lance Hornsby quietly seizes Alexandria, Hilltop and Oceanside as Commonwealth vassals when Maggie refuses to submit. Carol kills him after he betrays them.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Converts the Commonwealth from ally to occupier and sets up the citywide fight.

beats.label: S11 · Sebastian exposed
beats.text: Max records the Governor's spoiled son Sebastian ranting that Commonwealth citizens are weak. Sebastian dies to a walker during the reveal, and Eugene is arrested for his murder.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cracks Pamela's regime open and sets Eugene's public trial as the rallying point.

beats.label: S11 · The rebellion
beats.text: To crush a growing rebellion Pamela lures a variant-walker herd into her own city. Mercer defects to the coalition; Judith is shot by Pamela, and the alliance saves the Commonwealth.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Delivers the final overthrow and locks in Pamela's defeat.

beats.label: S11 · Endings
beats.text: Rosita dies of a walker bite. A year later Ezekiel governs the Commonwealth. Daryl and Michonne separately hunt for Rick, who has been forced to surrender to the CRM on Bloodsworth Island.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Closes the community arc and re-opens the Rick–Michonne thread as the series' last mystery.

cliffhanger.text: The Commonwealth is under new leadership, but the story's oldest thread — Rick's fate — is open again. Rick is a captive of the CRM, and Daryl and Michonne are separately hunting for him.
questions: Will Michonne or Daryl reach Rick first?
What is the CRM, and why has it kept Rick this long?
Can the united communities hold together without Rick, Michonne or Daryl?

characters.name: Rick Grimes
characters.line: Revealed to have been forced to surrender to the CRM on Bloodsworth Island; Daryl and Michonne are separately hunting for him.

characters.name: Daryl Dixon
characters.line: Was briefly wearing Commonwealth armour under Lance Hornsby; now a leader of the coalition and setting out to find Rick.

characters.name: Maggie Rhee
characters.line: Retook Meridian from the Reapers and leads Hilltop; refused to become a Commonwealth vassal and joined the rebellion against Pamela.

characters.name: Negan
characters.line: Fought alongside Maggie's team against the Reapers but abandoned her mid-escape; later married a woman named Annie and quietly reintegrated.

characters.name: Ezekiel
characters.line: Terminally ill through much of the season; now governs the Commonwealth a year after the alliance's victory over Pamela.

characters.name: Michonne
characters.line: Absent hunting for Rick; still searching for him as the story ends.

characters.name: Eugene Porter
characters.line: Fell in love with Stephanie inside the Commonwealth; helped Max play her recording of Sebastian publicly, was framed for his death, and helped ignite the rebellion.

characters.name: Pamela Milton
characters.line: Governor of the Commonwealth, a wealthy walled city; shot Judith and lured a variant-walker herd into her own streets to crush the rebellion, and lost.
